tools.name: Ghidra
tools.description: NSA's open-source reverse engineering suite: disassembler, decompiler, debugger and scripting in Java/Python.

tools.name: radare2
tools.description: The classic command-line reverse engineering framework: disassembly, analysis, debugging, binary patching.

tools.name: rizin
tools.description: Modern fork of radare2 focused on a cleaner codebase, Cutter GUI integration and better analysis.

tools.name: Cutter
tools.description: The official GUI for radare2/rizin. Visual disassembly, decompilation, graph views, scripting console.

tools.name: x64dbg
tools.description: Open-source user-mode debugger for Windows x64/x32 with a huge plugin ecosystem.

tools.name: IDA Free
tools.description: The free edition of the industry-standard IDA disassembler; no decompiler, limited to non-commercial use.

tools.name: Binary Ninja
tools.description: Modern commercial RE platform loved for its fast analysis, ILs and excellent Python API.

tools.name: Ghidra vs IDA
tools.description: Comparison page seed: Ghidra (free, decompiler included) vs IDA Pro (industry standard, expensive).

tools.name: jadx
tools.description: Decompile Android DEX/APK files back to Java source. The default first tool for Android RE.

tools.name: apktool
tools.description: Decode and rebuild APK resources (smali + resources.arsc). Essential for Android modding.

tools.name: Frida
tools.description: Dynamic instrumentation toolkit. Hook functions, trace calls, and patch apps at runtime on any major platform.

tools.name: MobSF
tools.description: Automated mobile app security scanner: static + dynamic analysis of Android/iOS binaries.

tools.name: APKiD
tools.description: Identifies compilers, packers, obfuscators and protectors used in APKs — Android's answer to PEiD.

tools.name: objection
tools.description: Runtime mobile exploration toolkit built on Frida: bypass SSL pinning, dump memory, explore apps without writing scripts.

tools.name: BlackDex
tools.description: Unpack/dump DEX from apps protected by packers, running on the device itself.

tools.name: unidbg
tools.description: Emulate Android native libraries on a PC without a real device; heavily used for unpacking and algorithm analysis.

tools.name: dnSpyEx
tools.description: Community-maintained fork of the legendary dnSpy: .NET debugger, decompiler and assembly editor in one.

tools.name: ILSpy
tools.description: The standard open-source .NET decompiler with a cross-platform Avalonia UI.

tools.name: de4dot
tools.description: Deobfuscator for dozens of .NET obfuscators (archived repo, still widely used).

tools.name: Detect It Easy (DIE)
tools.description: Fast file type / compiler / packer identification with a signature-script system. Successor to PEiD.

tools.name: UPX
tools.description: The most common executable packer — and the first packer every reverser learns to unpack.

tools.name: TrID
tools.description: File type identifier with thousands of definitions; useful when extensions lie.

tools.name: ScyllaHide
tools.description: Advanced anti-anti-debug plugin for x64dbg and other debuggers.

tools.name: angr
tools.description: Python framework for symbolic execution, concolic analysis and automated binary analysis research.

tools.name: capstone
tools.description: The disassembly engine behind most modern RE tools; multi-architecture, multi-language bindings.

tools.name: LIEF
tools.description: Library to parse and modify ELF, PE and Mach-O formats from Python/C++.

tools.name: YARA
tools.description: Pattern-matching tool for malware classification and triage; the standard in threat hunting.

tools.name: binwalk
tools.description: Firmware analysis and extraction: find embedded files and filesystems inside any binary blob.

tools.name: FACT_core
tools.description: Full-scale firmware analysis framework: unpacks, compares and compares firmware images automatically.

tools.name: emulating firmware: FirmAE
tools.description: Automated emulation framework for running IoT firmware in a virtualized environment.

tools.name: UEFITool
tools.description: Parse, extract and modify UEFI firmware images.

tools.name: pwndbg
tools.description: Feature-rich GDB plugin with context displays, heap analysis and exploit-dev helpers.

tools.name: GEF
tools.description: GDB Enhanced Features: shellcode helpers, pattern search and exploit development commands.

tools.name: mitmproxy
tools.description: Interactive HTTPS proxy for intercepting and modifying app traffic — key for mobile app RE.

tools.name: FLARE VM
tools.description: Mandiant's Windows-based malware analysis virtual machine: comes preloaded with all major RE tools.

tools.name: REMnux
tools.description: Linux distro for malware reverse engineering with hundreds of tools preinstalled.

tools.name: Bytecode Viewer
tools.description: All-in-one Java reverse engineering suite: decompile with multiple engines, edit bytecode, APK support.

tools.name: dex2jar
tools.description: Convert Android DEX files to JAR so classic Java tools can read them.

tools.name: Quark Engine
tools.description: Android malware analysis engine using Dalvik bytecode rules to score suspicious behavior.

tools.name: Cheat Engine
tools.description: Memory scanner and debugger — the classic entry point into game reverse engineering.

tools.name: ReClassEx
tools.description: Live memory structure reconstruction tool for reverse engineered classes/structs.
